title: llm-usage-metrics optimize report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for optimize report --json output.

data.description: Baseline and candidate rows in render order.

rowCommon.description: Fields shared by baseline and candidate rows.

provider.description: Provider the baseline is scoped to.

baselineRow.description: Observed usage priced at the actual models.

baselineCostUsd.description: Observed cost in USD; omitted when pricing is unresolved.

baselineCostIncomplete.description: True when some baseline events lack resolved pricing.

candidateRow.description: The same usage hypothetically priced at a candidate model.

candidateResolvedModel.description: Pricing key the candidate resolved to.

hypotheticalCostUsd.description: Hypothetical cost in USD; omitted when pricing is unresolved.

hypotheticalCostIncomplete.description: True when some candidate events lack resolved pricing.

savingsUsd.description: baseline minus hypothetical cost; negative means a cost increase; omitted when unresolved.

savingsRatio.description: savingsUsd / baseline cost as a 0-centered fraction; omitted when unresolved.
